unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: Reviewed kana evidence is not yet consumed by both speech turns and typed answers
unresolvedPublicationFindings.current: The reviewed reading sheet is off-schema. RolePlayStep passes acceptedAnswers only for turn one, and its second-turn required tokens come only from canonical cloze answers. ComplicationStep and TypeRecallStep accept only explicitly integrated acceptedAnswers; the CJK checker removes spaces but cannot convert kanji/kana.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.impact: If these drafts were published with a canonical-only adapter, correct kana-only input or ASR could be rejected, including the second spoken reply. Text-level reading approval alone does not prove runtime acceptance.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.concreteFix: Before publication, implement and independently test a reviewed-sidecar adapter for canonical plus exact authored kana cloze/recall answers and both spoken replies, and honor reviewed token-pair alternatives where token scoring is used. Keep canonical TTS surfaces single-counted and keep current recording/scoring settings pending the measured pilot. This is deferred integration work, not a change requested to the approved canonical audio text.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.verification: Exercise canonical, unspaced kana and reviewed alternative-kanji input on both role-play turns and every typed answer in the real Japanese B1 fixture.

unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: German-only pattern headings remain visible to English-base learners
unresolvedPublicationFindings.current: All 20 pattern.label values contain German explanatory headings. PatternStep prints pattern.label directly, and collectGuidedBaseFields visits only objects, so a bare string label is not localized by a generated base edition.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.impact: English-base learners receive an untranslated German heading even though rule and example translations are available in English.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.concreteFix: Before publication, supply an approved locale-aware pattern-label mapping, or exact bilingual labels in the existing string field as already done for form cues. Keep source status draft until the chosen publication path is tested.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.verification: Render all pattern labels with German and English base preferences and confirm each heading is understandable. Label edits do not alter the canonical spoken surfaces.

scope: Exact canonical spoken text for local TTS only. Full kana sidecar is review evidence, never additional synthesized inventory. Complete nonspoken findings remain publication holds; no human-native, listening or publication approval.

reviewer.id: Fable 5.1 full twenty-lesson and full authored kana read

readThrough.checks: Every field of all ten lessons read against the spec: four-turn tuple shape; dialogue[0] 19–26 chars/4–6 units, dialogue[2] 18–23 chars, dialogue[1] 21–28 chars with 4 chunks whose space-join reproduces targetText, dialogue[3] 16–25 chars; cloze reconstructs dialogue[3] with 2 form blanks each carrying a visible bilingual cue, 4 distinct choices, answer ≤3 units; recall before+answer+after reproduces dialogue[1], answers are content units, 4 distinct fallbacks; speakRequired are three distinct whole units ≥2 chars, kana/CJK only, no particles/fillers/gendered words; trophy surface units verified by start-anchored exact remainder (で/と/に/が/は/でした/empty) in dialogue[1] and example; pattern highlights contiguous, example 0 = learner line; captions quote dialogue[0] exactly once, no other Japanese, no spoiler in situation/caption; staging: L1–3 て-chains + sequencers only, L4 first ていました/時/たら, L5 ていた時+たら, L6 discovery たら, L7+ てから/ので; ていました in L1 opener and 作ったんですね are interlocutor-only; no sentence-final plain, no gendered particles, kanji numerals only (二十分), wakachigaki clean; German pedagogicalGoal and de+en on every base field.
readThrough.remainingConcerns: L7 opener contradicted its own timeline (asks whether parents have arrived yet, then where you met them yesterday) — fixed below. L3 dialogue[3] 川まで 歩いて 帰りました is acceptable but mildly compressed (walked to the river, then home); L9 dialogue[3] answers the change question only implicitly (いいえ + shared laughter); both kept. Trophy uniqueness against A1/A2 relies on the author's import of the frozen modules; not re-verifiable here.

readThrough.checks: All ten lessons read field by field: lengths in range (dialogue[1] 21–26 chars, dialogue[3] 17–24), chunk joins exact, cloze and recall reconstructions exact, speakRequired valid whole units, trophy surfaces honest (ですが/です/は/も/empty remainders), captions clean, no spoilers. Staging: L1–2 と思います + clause-medial けど only; L3 the licensed fixed 確かに+evaluative+けど+polite main clause frame; L4–6 ても/だけでも and し (polite 賛成ですし accepted); L7–10 かもしれません and と思いますが; no なら/ば/たら in any learner line; 買おう, 良さそう, 一緒だと, ために, てもらえませんか occur only in interlocutor turns. Form blanks whose distractors are grammatical in isolation (L1 便利で, L2 高く, L6 難しく, L7 思って, L9 あります, L10 忙しいです) are disambiguated by the authored visible cue naming けど/かもしれません/が, which the spec permits for form blanks. Register: polite throughout, 私 only in L1 opener, no gendered forms.
readThrough.remainingConcerns: L2 learner line stated 便利です。 and 出費が 多い as two unlinked sentences, which reads choppy and non-native for a weighing turn — fixed with the A2-recycled ですが concession so the trophy tail stays on the allowlist. L5 uses 賛成 as ordinary vocabulary two lessons before its trophy lesson (accepted, no award). L9 opener 仕事の ために 役立ちますか is acceptable (cf. 将来のために役立つ). L2 pattern label keeps ですけど while example 0 now uses ですが; rule text adjusted.

readingSheetRead.checks: All 460 canonical/kana rows read; each kana row matches its canonical pointer's spacing and punctuation, keeps topic は (きのうは, しごとには) and directional へ (いえへ), and gives the correct lexical reading (ひっこし, しゅっちょう, かわぞい, しゃない, にじゅっぷん, あまやどり, とりにく, にました, おふたり, でんち, どうきゅうせい, ぶじ, しゅっぴ, ちゅうしゃじょう, ひあたり, やちん, こうがい, らく, ざんぎょう, ひよう, にってい, まにあわない, しかく, きょうじゅう). All 60 speak token pairs align with the kana row unit. All 40 trophy surface records use exact start-anchored remainders on the allowlist (particle で/と/に/が/は/も, copula です/でした/ですが, none). Readings are reviewed as text only; no accent certification.
readingSheetRead.remainingConcerns: The sidecar has no slot for alternative ASR spellings the spec asks the reviewer to list (友達/友だち for P1 L3, 皆/みんな for P2 L7–8); add when the token-pair schema gains that field. Three sidecar rows plus one token and one surface record change with the edits below, so the sidecar hash will move.
